patterns.note: High-contrast dark theme with a vibrant, almost neon, accent color (lime green/yellow) used for key headings, CTAs, and interactive elements, creating a bold and modern aesthetic.
Extensive use of full-width horizontal carousels for showcasing case studies and articles, breaking from typical vertical content flow and allowing for high visual content density.
Distinctive pairing of an ultra-bold, slightly condensed display font for hero and section titles with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text, establishing a clear typographic hierarchy.
The header transforms from transparent to a solid dark background with breadcrumbs on scroll, while remaining sticky at the top of the viewport.
The hero section features a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
Content sections frequently employ large, image-rich cards within horizontal carousels, allowing for a high density of visual content without excessive vertical scrolling.

technique_notes: The site uses a combination of CSS keyframes for subtle element animations and the Swiper library for interactive horizontal content carousels. Scroll-triggered effects include a sticky header that transitions its background and reveals breadcrumbs, and a hero section with a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax depth effect.

A deep charcoal or dark blue-grey background is paired with light grey body text and a very bright, almost fluorescent, yellow-green for primary headings, call-to-action buttons, and interactive highlights, creating a high-contrast dark theme.

Multiple sections feature full-width horizontal carousels, allowing users to swipe or click through a series of large, visually rich content cards (case studies, articles) without adding significant vertical scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, ultra-bold display headings (Fhoscar) create strong visual impact, contrasting with clean, readable sans-serif body text (Manrope) and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards and input fields, with some elements like the primary CTA button using a pill shape for emphasis.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and main section breaks, transitioning to a balanced density within content grids and horizontal carousels.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the bold, high-contrast color scheme, pairing a deep, dark background with a vibrant, almost neon yellow-green accent. This, combined with the extensive use of large, image-rich horizontal carousels for showcasing work, creates a dynamic and visually engaging experience that feels both professional and modern, moving beyond a standard grid layout.
